description: This file defines the CasesJjwg_MapsLogicHook class that implements logic hooks for the Cases module, primarily to manage geocode information updates related to the jjwg_Maps module. It contains methods triggered on various lifecycle events such as save, relationship addition, and deletion.

classes.name: CasesJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class that implements logic hooks to update geocode information for case records in relation to the jjwg_Maps module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class by fetching module info for 'jjwg_Maps'.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Triggered before saving a case; updates geocode info if the hook is enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Triggered after saving a case; updates geocode info of related meetings if enabled.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Triggered after adding a relationship; updates geocode info for the related focus record if hook is enabled.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Triggered after deleting a relationship; updates geocode info for the focus record if hook is enabled.
